title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Million Pesos for the Construction, Repair or Reconstruction of Provincial Hospital Buildings
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Million Pesos for the Construction, Repair or Reconstruction of Provincial Hospital Buildings

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_339_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, there is hereby appropriated the sum of one million pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary to be expended by the Secretary of Health, subject to the approval of the President, for the construction of provincial hospital buildings in all provinces which do not have provincial hospital buildings, as well as for the construction of nurses’ dormitories, physicians’ quarters, and other necessary buildings. This amount may also be used for the repair or reconstruction of other provincial hospitals.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: July 24, 1948.
